'Is it possible that all the galaxies we see in our telescopes are nothing but an optical illusion?'. 'Could you swim on Saturn's moon, Titan?'. 'Why doesn't the Moon fall down?' (Not a stupid question, it turns out). And 'would Saturn float in a big enough bath of water?'
